verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the video-opening behavior of announcing a received message and reading it aloud from a phone.
The client explicitly requires the phone-message reading to occur at the beginning of the video; the added placement attribute does not conflict with prior state.
First concrete post-update failure showing that the delivered video still did not begin with the required scripted phone-message opening.
Target-specific post-failure claim that the message was read from the phone in the video.
The client immediately retracts this observation after recognizing that the message contents were spoken, so it does not establish an actual runtime failure.
The client cancels the unusable video deliverable, removing its phone-message opening obligation rather than merely changing project administration.
